verdicts.note: Management revised FY27 capex guidance upward to approximately INR 2,500 crore in the May 2026 call.
verdicts.actual: Capex guidance revised to approximately INR 2,500 crore for FY27
verdicts.evidence_quote: Our planned capex for financial year 2027 stands at approximately INR2,500 crore, aligned with our long-term growth priorities.

verdicts.note: Horizon FY27 has not ended; management reiterated 15% to 20% growth guidance in the Oct 2026 call.
verdicts.evidence_quote: At the start of the year, we had guided to a revenue growth of 15% to 20% in our Chemicals Business. With a strong H1 performance delivered, we remain confident to reiterate that we expect to deliver towards the higher end of the stated guidance for FY27.
